name: java_tax_calculator
description: Primary path: a deterministic Python re-implementation that decodes the embedded triple-base64 bracket constants (or extracts the table from the source/comments), validates against the worked examples, computes the hidden salaries, and prefixes the grader's pinned java version. Near-instant so it always emits before the kill budget. An optional javac repair-run fallback (off by default) handles rare unparseable variants on a JDK-equipped box.

task_description.description: The question text, including the hidden salary cases.

source_file.description: Path to the declared Java source file. Relative paths resolve against the question directory.
